title: US 25% Tariff on India: Fake or Fact?

segments.text: Trump just hit India with a twenty-five percent tariff. Or did he?
Three facts. One: the US proposed tariffs of up to twenty-five percent on all Indian goods.
It blames Indian overcapacity in pharma, steel and solar.
Of fourteen economies, only Vietnam's proposed rate is higher.
Two: India says it has no excess capacity in any sector. But here's the catch.

segments.claim: The 25% tariff is already in force
segments.text: Three: is it already in force? Fake. It's only a proposal, and per Reuters, nothing starts before a January hearing.
The twist? Sign a trade deal, and India's rate drops to seventeen percent.
That's below China, Vietnam, even Bangladesh.
